notReplayed.sendChatCompletionRequest#doc OAuth Step: The page supplies an unversioned live alias without its historical binding or availability date. A frozen World cannot identify which dated model it selects; pinned GPT-4/GPT-4o and GPT-5.2 examples exercise the same chat operation without inventing that binding.
notReplayed.sendChatCompletionRequest#doc upstream d: A World runs no provider model and has no upstream transformed request. This real-provider debug payload cannot be produced truthfully; debug and provider routing are outside demand.
notReplayed.createResponses#doc upstream debug echo: A World runs no provider model and has no upstream transformed request. This real-provider debug payload cannot be produced truthfully; debug and provider routing are outside demand.
notReplayed.sendChatCompletionRequest#doc OAuth Step: The published SDK variant explicitly sends stream:false. Its unversioned live alias has no documented dated binding, so the frozen World cannot select a known dated model. The fetch variant is the existing live-latest-alias record.
notReplayed.sendChatCompletionRequest#doc stream can: The SDK, Python and fetch variants publish the same request but exercise connection abort and provider processing/billing cancellation. The journey data format has no abort action and this World has no progressive provider execution or billing to stop. A normal completed stream would not replay the cancellation. This is a missing shared kernel/walk mechanism if cancellation is to become reachable.
notReplayed.sendChatCompletionRequest#doc guardrail: A configured content/prompt-injection guardrail is required, and guardrail configuration/evaluation is unmodeled in this World. A generic permission fault lacks the published detection metadata and cannot replay it.

The example requires an installed guardrail plus opted-in provider/router pipeline metadata. Neither configured guardrails nor the router pipeline exist in this World.
